rationale: The response maintains an indignant, sworn-testimony register throughout, reframing the lack of denim as more American by citing historical figures and questioning the premise.
quote: George Washington did not wear jeans at Valley Forge. I have it on good authority that the Founding Fathers grilled in breeches. Denim, gentlemen, was invented by a man named *Levi Strauss*—and I need not remind this committee where he emigrated *from*.
